description: This file provides declarations of utility functions related to PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) objects and ASN.1 encoding, including functions for validating extensions, finding attributes, converting OID strings to signature and key types, and copying trimmed strings.

methods.name: PKIIsExtensionsObjectValid
methods.description: Checks if a given extensions object is valid within ASN.1 PKI context.

methods.name: FindAttributeWithOIDType
methods.description: Finds an attribute within a PKI object by its OID string.

methods.name: PKIOIDStringToSignatureType
methods.description: Converts an OID string to its corresponding signature type enumeration.

methods.name: PKISignTypeToOIDString
methods.description: Converts a signature type enumeration into its corresponding OID string.

methods.name: PKIOIDStringToKeyType
methods.description: Converts an OID string to its corresponding key type enumeration.

methods.name: PKIKeyTypeToOIDString
methods.description: Converts a key type enumeration into its corresponding OID string.

methods.name: PKICopyStringAfterTrim
methods.description: Copies a source string to a destination buffer, trimming spaces from both ends.
